ten: Series · Fox Tales — Aesop (sáp màu trẻ con, tập 2 thử)
mo_ta: Series hoạt hình gia đình: cáo Felix lém lỉnh thắng mọi mưu, trừ một con vật nhỏ mỗi tập — kẻ thắng bằng bài học của một truyện ngụ ngôn Aesop (truyện công cộng). Tiếng Anh, toàn cầu.

kinh_thanh.phong_cach: Looks exactly like a drawing made by a 6-year-old child using ONLY wax crayons on plain white paper: thick waxy crayon strokes with the rough paper grain showing through, wobbly shaky uneven outlines, scribbly back-and-forth coloring that goes outside the lines with gaps and overlaps, bright primary crayon colors, big round heads, simple stick-like arms and legs, naive wrong proportions and perspective, a big yellow crayon sun with rays in a corner, grass as a strip of green zigzag crayon scribbles, sky as a scribbled blue band at the top, lots of white paper showing, charming and innocent like a fridge drawing; vertical 9:16 frame. Clean frames with no text, letters, numbers or logos anywhere.
kinh_thanh.logline: Felix wants the crow's big piece of cheese and tries flattery, but this crow has heard the fable before.
kinh_thanh.chu_de: It's easy to hate what you can't have

series.dong_co: Felix the fox is the cleverest trickster in the forest and wins every scheme — except against one small animal per episode, who beats him with the moral of a classic Aesop fable.
series.khan_gia: families: kids 5–10 and their parents (global, English); safe, kind, no scary content
series.dinh_dang: YouTube Shorts 45–60s vertical, one fable per episode, moral spoken at the end; long-form compilation of 5 fables every two weeks

tap.logline: Felix wants the perfect purple grapes at the top of the vine, but every clever plan to reach them fails — so he decides they must be sour.
Felix wants the crow's big piece of cheese and tries flattery, but this crow has heard the fable before.
Felix wants to fool the stork with soup on a flat plate, but the stork returns the favor with a tall narrow jar.
Felix wants to win the forest race against the tortoise, but he is so sure of winning that he stops for a nap.
Felix wants to trap little Pip for good, but when a lion's net catches Felix, only Pip can save him.
Felix wants a laugh by faking a wolf alarm at the village, but when a real wolf comes no one believes him.
Felix wants to dance all summer with the grasshopper, but winter comes and only the ants have food.

tap.ten: The Goose and the Golden Egg
tap.logline: Felix wants all the golden eggs at once, but greed could end the magic forever.

tap.ten: The North Wind and the Sun
tap.logline: Felix bets he can take a traveler's coat by force, but the gentle sun wins the bet.

tap.ten: The Fox Who Lost His Tail
tap.logline: Felix loses his tail in a trap and wants every fox to cut theirs too, but his friends see through the trick.

nhan_vat.mo_ta: Felix the fox as a stylized 3D animated character: slim young red fox standing on two legs, bright orange fur with a white chest and white tail tip, oversized bushy tail, big amber eyes, one slightly bent left ear, small green neckerchief; confident, scheming, dramatic, lovable

Pip the mouse as a stylized 3D animated character: tiny round field mouse with soft light-brown fur, huge pink ears, big shiny black eyes, a tiny blue scarf, quick and cheerful, very small next to Felix
The crow as a stylized 3D animated character: glossy blue-black feathers, sharp yellow beak, clever squinting eyes, a big wedge of yellow cheese held in its beak

A sunny countryside vineyard at golden hour: an old wooden trellis with a very tall twisting grapevine, plump glowing purple grapes hanging high at the top, soft grass, wildflowers, a puddle, a bramble bush, a log and a wooden bucket nearby, rolling green hills behind
The stork as a character: very tall thin white bird with long thin orange legs, a very long pointed orange beak, black wing tips, elegant and polite, always carrying a tall narrow clay jar

tap.brief: Tập 2 'Fox Tales' (vẽ đơn nét kiểu sách tranh). Hook: miếng phô mai to nhất trên mỏ quạ. Vấn đề: Felix dùng mưu nịnh của truyện Aesop. Leo thang: khen lông, tặng vương miện, dựng sân khấu có đèn đom đóm — quạ vẫn ngậm chặt. Lật ngược: quạ kẹp phô mai bằng chân rồi hát hay tuyệt, phô mai không rơi: 'I know that story, Felix.' Kết: Pip chia bánh quy, bài học 'đừng tin lời nịnh'. Móc: cò mang lọ cao cổ đi ngang, mời Felix ăn tối → tập 3.
